description: This file defines the JSHandle class used for handling JavaScript objects within the Playwright automation framework, including methods for evaluation, property access, serialization, and disposal.

classes.name: JSHandle
classes.description: Represents a handle to a JavaScript object in the page context, providing methods to evaluate scripts, access properties, and serialize the object.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates a JSHandle instance from a channel object.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a function within the inspected page context.

methods.name: _evaluateFunction
methods.description: Evaluates a JavaScript function as a string in the page context.

methods.name: evaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a function and returns a handle to the result.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property of the object.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves all properties of the object.

methods.name: jsonValue
methods.description: Serializes the object to a JSON value.

methods.name: asElement
methods.description: Returns the DOM element if the handle points to one.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string preview of the handle.
